questions.title: Will the Belgian State and Engie conclude an agreement for Belgium's acquisition of Engie's nuclear activities before December 14, 2026?
questions.background:
Euronext: [Engie and Belgium government to take more time to conclude deal over Engie's nuclear assets](https://live.euronext.com/en/financial-news/engie-and-belgium-government-take-more-time-conclude-deal-over-engies-nuclear-assets)

`{"format": "bot_tournament_question", "info": {"hash_id": "0ac6ba6aeae82164", "sheet_id": "132"}}`
questions.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, before December 14, 2026 (Central European Time), according to [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) the Belgian State and Engie S.A. and/or Electrabel formally agree to a Heads of Terms (HoT) for the Belgian State's acquisition of Engie's Belgian nuclear activities. The question resolves as **No** if no qualifying agreement has been concluded by the deadline. An extension alone does not count as a qualifying agreement.
questions.fine_print: An agreement counts even if it covers only part of the assets originally under discussion. An agreement may be variously described as Heads of Terms, a protocol of agreement, or a memorandum of understanding. An "agreement in principle" that has not been formalised, an approval by only one side, or statements that a deal is close or imminent do not count.
